items.headline: Carlos Baleba plays first Man Utd minutes in behind-closed-doors friendly
items.summary: Summer signing Carlos Baleba made his first appearance for United in a behind-closed-doors match against Lausanne-Sport, continuing recovery from his ankle injury ahead of Tottenham clash.

items.headline: David Raum keen on Manchester United move in January transfer window
items.summary: RB Leipzig captain David Raum is reportedly willing to join Manchester United in January when his contract expires, as left-back pursuit continues.

items.headline: Manchester United face injury concerns during international break
items.summary: Multiple United players picked up injuries during international duty, creating concerns ahead of upcoming Premier League fixtures and Tottenham match.
